faq_heading: Questions teams ask about AI calling agents and telecallers

faqs.q: Is an AI calling agent better than a human telecaller?
faqs.a: It depends on the call. An AI calling agent is better at speed, volume and consistency on routine calls such as first-touch lead calls, reminders and follow-ups. A human telecaller is better at negotiation, upset customers and unusual questions. Most teams get the best result by giving each type of call to the one that suits it.

faqs.q: Will an AI calling agent replace my telecallers?
faqs.a: Clara AI does not position it that way. The agent takes the repetitive first calls and follow-ups, and your telecallers spend their time on warm leads, negotiation and sensitive conversations. How you organise your team is your decision.

faqs.q: Can an AI calling agent speak Hindi and Arabic?
faqs.a: Yes. Clara AI's calling agents work in English, Hindi and Arabic. Each language is tested on real calls from your business before launch, including mixed-language speech such as Hindi and English.

faqs.q: Does the person on the call know it is an AI?
faqs.a: Yes. The agent says at the start that it is an automated assistant, and the person can ask for a human at any time. Consent, telemarketing and data-protection rules apply to AI calls, and Clara AI builds within them.

faqs.q: What does an AI calling agent do when it cannot answer?
faqs.a: It says it does not know, offers a callback from a person and passes your team a short summary of the call. It does not guess on pricing, contracts or anything outside the information you approved.
